tools.name: get_services_pricing
tools.description: Returns Relux Works services, fixed-price packages, company facts, selected work, supported languages, and market-specific planning prices. Tool and service identifiers remain in English.

tools.name: request_project_quote
tools.description: Creates and immediately sends an external project inquiry to a private Relux Works Telegram chat for human review. Do not call it to test the connector or demonstrate MCP. Build the summary from known conversation context, ask only for missing details, obtain a real user-provided or user-confirmed r

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_project_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Creates and immediately sends an external project inquiry to a private Relux Works Telegram chat for human review. Do not call it to test the connector or demon…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "request_project_quote" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
